webpage.text:
Atocha Alpaca Wool Throw Blanket – Coffee Stripes 
      
      
       – ECUALAMA INC

Guaranteed safe & secure checkout

Payment methods


Soft Baby Alpaca. Coffee Stripes. Handmade in Otavalo.

Atocha is our understated favourite: fine coffee, cream and cocoa stripes on a soft baby alpaca-blend throw that suits any room.

Woven by hand in Otavalo, Ecuador — the textile capital of the Andes — from a baby alpaca wool blend — baby alpaca is finer and softer than regular alpaca and naturally lanolin-free and gentle on sensitive skin. It washes easily and dries fast, which is why customers who buy one usually come back for a second.


Why you’ll love it

 * Baby alpaca – soft, smooth and naturally lanolin-free
 * Warm without weight – winter nights and summer evenings alike
 * Queen size – covers the bed or two people on the sofa
 * Easy care – washes well and dries fast
 * Hand-woven in Otavalo – fair-trade artisan work from Ecuador


Details

 * Material: 80% baby alpaca / 20% acrylic — the acrylic keeps the blanket soft, washable and in shape for years
 * Size: Queen — 90" x 63" (230 x 160 cm)
 * Weight: approx. 780 g / 1.7 lb
 * Colours: Coffee mix — thin stripes in browns, creams and warm neutrals
 * Made in: Otavalo, Ecuador — fair trade, artisan woven

“Baby alpaca” is the name of the finest grade of alpaca fibre, not the age of the animal — alpacas are shorn once a year, like sheep. And it is not a blanket for babies: this is a full-size adult blanket.


Warmth & fit

Lightweight warmth: alpaca insulates far better than its weight suggests, so this blanket is warm on a winter night yet comfortable as a summer throw. Large enough to cover a queen bed as a top layer or two people on the sofa.


Care

 * Hand wash cold with a mild detergent (or delicate cycle in a mesh bag)
 * Do not bleach or tumble dry
 * Lay flat or hang with support to dry, out of direct sun
 * Steam or low iron with a cloth if needed

Handmade, so no two are identical. Each piece is woven and dyed by hand in Otavalo, Ecuador. Colours can be a shade lighter or darker than on screen, and fringe and pattern placement vary slightly — that is the signature of a real artisan piece, not a flaw.

Shipping & gift. Dispatched from Ecuador within 1 business day. US orders travel FedEx Express — typically at your door in 3–5 business days, duties covered. We ship worldwide by express courier (DHL, FedEx or UPS), typically 3–10 business days; local duties and taxes may apply outside the US. Every order includes a small surprise from Ecuador.
